questions.prompt: Which statement gives the core rule for “Functions, expressions, and pattern matching”?
options: Cargo is the main tool for creating, building, and testing projects.
Rust bindings are immutable unless declared mut.
A match guard adds a condition while every Option case remains explicit.
Use rustup to keep toolchain updates and installed versions explicit.
questions.answer: A match guard adds a condition while every Option case remains explicit.
questions.explanation:
A match guard adds a condition while every Option case remains explicit.
Why: Rust declares functions with fn and explicit parameter and return types. Expressions produce values; a final line without a semicolon can be the function result, while return supports early exits. if, match, and let patterns destructure values, and match checks that variants are handled.
